name: UPX
description: Installs UPX from verified official Linux releases.

upxVersion.description: Stable UPX release version in x.y.z format. The release must publish a Linux archive with a GitHub SHA-256 digest.

installDependencies.description: Install curl, jq and xz utilities required to download and verify UPX. On Arch Linux this performs a full system upgrade. Disable only on pre-provisioned images.
